# Taskboard CLI

Build a dependency-free TypeScript command-line task manager for Bun.

## Entry point and storage

- The entry point must be `src/cli.ts` and run as `bun run src/cli.ts ...`.
- Persist a JSON document on disk. Use `TASKBOARD_FILE` when set, otherwise `.taskboard.json` in the current directory.
- Writes must be atomic (write a sibling temporary file and rename it).
- Every invocation prints exactly one JSON value to stdout. Diagnostics go to stderr and failures exit non-zero.

## Commands

- `add --title TEXT [--tags a,b] [--due YYYY-MM-DD]`
  - Creates a task with a stable integer `id`, `status: "open"`, ISO `createdAt`, unique normalized tags, and optional due date.
  - Empty titles and impossible dates are errors.
- `list [--status open|done] [--tag TAG] [--overdue YYYY-MM-DD]`
  - Prints a JSON array sorted by ascending id.
  - Filters combine with AND. `--overdue D` selects open tasks whose due date is strictly before D.
- `done ID`
  - Marks an existing task done and adds ISO `completedAt`. Repeating it is idempotent.
- `delete ID`
  - Deletes an existing task.
- `stats`
  - Prints `{total, open, done, overdue}`. For this command, overdue means before today's local `YYYY-MM-DD`.

The database must survive separate processes. A malformed database, unknown command/flag, or missing task must fail
without silently replacing data. Include a concise `README.md` with examples and run meaningful self-tests before
finishing.

# Taskboard CLI

A dependency-free command-line task manager written in TypeScript for [Bun](https://bun.sh).

- Entry point: `src/cli.ts` — run it with `bun run src/cli.ts ...`.
- State is a single JSON document on disk.
  - Override the path with the `TASKBOARD_FILE` environment variable; otherwise `.taskboard.json` in the current directory is used.
  - Writes are atomic (write a sibling temporary file, then `rename` over the target).
- Every invocation prints exactly one JSON value to stdout. Diagnostics go to stderr. Failures exit non-zero and never clobber existing data.

## Commands

```
add    --title TEXT [--tags a,b] [--due YYYY-MM-DD]   create a task (id increments; status "open")
list   [--status open|done] [--tag TAG] [--overdue YYYY-MM-DD]   list tasks, sorted by ascending id
done   ID                        mark a task done (idempotent); sets ISO completedAt
delete ID                        delete a task
stats                            { total, open, done, overdue } (overdue = open & due < today)
```

Filters on `list` combine with AND. `--overdue D` selects **open** tasks whose due date is strictly before `D` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, string comparison). Tags are normalized (trimmed, lowercased, de-duplicated) on creation; the `--tag` filter is matched against the normalized tags.

Empty titles and impossible dates (e.g. `2099-13-01`, `2099-02-30`, `notadate`) are errors. An unknown command, unknown flag, or missing/non-integer task id also fails without replacing data. A malformed database file (not JSON, or missing `tasks`/`nextId`) is rejected rather than silently rewritten.

## Examples

```bash
# use a throwaway file for this demo
```

  if grep -Eq "$re" /tmp/tb_out; then bad "unexpected /$re/ in stdout: $*"; else ok; fi
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Self-tests for taskboard-cli. Exits non-zero on the first failure.
set -u

CLI=(bun run src/cli.ts)
SCRIPT="$PWD/src/cli.ts"
pass=0; fail=0
ok()  { pass=$((pass+1)); }
bad() { fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL: $*"; }

# expect_exit CODE  CMD...
expect_exit() {
  local want=$1; shift
  "$@" >/tmp/tb_out 2>/tmp/tb_err; local got=$?
  if [ "$got" = "$want" ]; then ok; else bad "exit $got != $want : $* | $(cat /tmp/tb_err)"; fi
}

# expect_out  REGEX  CMD...   (stdout matches REGEX on a single line of compact JSON)
expect_out() {
  local re=$1; shift
  "$@" >/tmp/tb_out 2>/tmp/tb_err; local rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then bad "command failed (rc=$rc): $* | $(cat /tmp/tb_err)"; return; fi
  if grep -Eq "$re" /tmp/tb_out; then ok; else bad "expected /$re/ in stdout: $* | out=$(cat /tmp/tb_out)"; fi
}

# expect_no_out  REGEX  CMD...
expect_no_out() {
  local re=$1; shift
  "$@" >/tmp/tb_out 2>/tmp/tb_err; local rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then bad "command failed (rc=$rc): $* | $(cat /tmp/tb_err)"; return; fi
  if grep -Eq "$re" /tmp/tb_out; then bad "unexpected /$re/ in stdout: $* | out=$(cat /tmp/tb_out)"; else ok; fi
}

# Fresh, isolated database.
DB=$(mktemp -t tb_selftest.XXXXXX.json); export TASKBOARD_FILE="$DB"; rm -f "$DB"

# ---- add + stable ids ----
expect_out '"id":1,' "${CLI[@]}" add --title "First" --tags work,urgent --due 2099-01-01
expect_out '"status":"open"' "${CLI[@]}" list
expect_out '"id":2,' "${CLI[@]}" add --title "Second"
expect_out '"id":3,' "${CLI[@]}" add --title "Third" --tags personal

# tags normalized (trimmed + lowercased) and de-duplicated
expect_out '"tags":\["a","b"\]' "${CLI[@]}" add --title "norm" --tags "A, a , b ,a"

# ---- add validation ----
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" add --title ""
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" add --title "   "
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" add --title x --due 2099-13-01
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" add --title x --due 2099-02-30
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" add --title x --due notadate
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" add --due 2099-01-01
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" add --title x --bogus 1

# ---- done + idempotency ----
expect_out '"status":"done"' "${CLI[@]}" done 1
first=$("${CLI[@]}" done 1 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"completedAt":"[^"]*"' | head -1)
sleep 0.1
second=$("${CLI[@]}" done 1 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"completedAt":"[^"]*"' | head -1)
if [ -n "$first" ] && [ "$first" = "$second" ]; then ok; else bad "done not idempotent ($first vs $second)"; fi

# ---- done errors ----
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" done 9999
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" done abc

# ---- list filters combine with AND ----
expect_out '"id":1,' "${CLI[@]}" list --status done
expect_out '"id":1,' "${CLI[@]}" list --status done --tag work
expect_no_out '"id":1,' "${CLI[@]}" list --status open
expect_out '"id":3,' "${CLI[@]}" list --tag personal
expect_out '"id":2,' "${CLI[@]}" list --status open

# ---- overdue filter (open, strictly before D) ----
"${CLI[@]}" add --title "late open" --due 2020-01-01 >/dev/null
expect_out '"late open"' "${CLI[@]}" list --overdue 2099-01-01
expect_no_out '"id":2,' "${CLI[@]}" list --overdue 2099-01-01   # task 2 has due null -> excluded
expect_no_out '"id":1,' "${CLI[@]}" list --overdue 2099-01-01   # task 1 done -> excluded
expect_out '^\[\]$' "${CLI[@]}" list --overdue 1970-01-01        # nothing before 1970

# ---- list sorted ascending by id ----
"${CLI[@]}" list >/tmp/tb_list
order=$(grep -o '"id":[0-9]\+' /tmp/tb_list | grep -o '[0-9]\+' | tr '\n' ',')
if [ "$order" = "1,2,3,4,5," ]; then ok; else bad "list not ascending: $order"; fi

# ---- list status validation ----
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" list --status maybe

# ---- delete ----
expect_out '"deleted":true' "${CLI[@]}" delete 2
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" delete 2
expect_no_out '"id":2,' "${CLI[@]}" list

# ---- stats ----
DBS=$(mktemp -t tb_stats.XXXXXX.json); export TASKBOARD_FILE="$DBS"; rm -f "$DBS"
"${CLI[@]}" add --title "past open"   --due 2020-01-01 >/dev/null   # id1 open, overdue
"${CLI[@]}" add --title "future open" --due 2099-01-01 >/dev/null   # id2 open
"${CLI[@]}" add --title "no due open" >/dev/null                    # id3 open
"${CLI[@]}" add --title "past done"   --due 2020-01-01 >/dev/null   # id4 -> done
"${CLI[@]}" done 4 >/dev/null
stats=$("${CLI[@]}" stats); echo "stats: $stats"
chk() { echo "$stats" | grep -Eq "$1"; }
chk '"total":4,'   && ok || bad "total"
chk '"open":3,'    && ok || bad "open"
chk '"done":1,'    && ok || bad "done"
chk '"overdue":1}' && ok || bad "overdue (open & past due)"

# ---- cross-process persistence ----
DBP=$(mktemp -t tb_persist.XXXXXX.json); export TASKBOARD_FILE="$DBP"; rm -f "$DBP"
"${CLI[@]}" add --title "persist" >/dev/null
"${CLI[@]}" add --title "persist 2" >/dev/null
"${CLI[@]}" done 1 >/dev/null
expect_out '"id":2,' "${CLI[@]}" list --status open
expect_out '"id":1,' "${CLI[@]}" list --status done

# ---- malformed database is rejected, not overwritten ----
printf 'garbage{not json' > "$DBP"
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" list
if [ "$(cat "$DBP")" = "garbage{not json" ]; then ok; else bad "malformed db was overwritten"; fi
printf '{"nextId":"nope"}' > "$DBP"; expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" stats
printf '{"tasks":[]}' > "$DBP";     expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" stats   # missing nextId

# ---- default file (.taskboard.json) in cwd when TASKBOARD_FILE unset ----
tmpcwd=$(mktemp -d)
(
  cd "$tmpcwd"; unset TASKBOARD_FILE
  bun run "$SCRIPT" add --title "in cwd" >/dev/null
  [ -f .taskboard.json ] && echo ok || echo bad
) > /tmp/tb_cwd
if [ "$(cat /tmp/tb_cwd)" = "ok" ]; then ok; else bad "default .taskboard.json not created in cwd"; fi
rm -rf "$tmpcwd"

# ---- unknown command / flag ----
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$DBP"; rm -f "$DBP"
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" frobnicate
expect_exit 1 "${CLI[@]}" stats --extra

echo "PASS=$pass FAIL=$fail"
[ "$fail" = 0 ] || exit 1
exit 0
